title: OpenHat Security
lead: These installs do not erase your iPhone unless you choose Level 3. The name on each button is the name iOS will show.
safari_note: Safari only — Chrome and in-app browsers will not install a profile.

sections.title: Level 1 — start here
sections.description: Private DNS plus Max Privacy restrictions. Mullvad blocks ads and trackers; Quad9 blocks malware. The phone only uses one DNS profile.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 1 (Mullvad)
profiles.subtitle: Encrypted DNS · ads and trackers blocked
profiles.description: Mullvad DNS, Apple analytics off, personalized ads off, tighter lock screen. Does not erase the iPhone.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 1 (Quad9)
profiles.subtitle: Encrypted DNS · malware blocked
profiles.description: Same Level 1 restrictions with Quad9 instead of Mullvad. Installing this replaces Level 1 (Mullvad).

sections.title: Level 2.1x — one extra
sections.description: Level 1 plus a single extra. .11 is stronger PIN. .12 is the Safari website list.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.11 (Mullvad)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + Extra 1.1 · PIN
profiles.description: Level 1 (Mullvad) plus a passcode policy: at least 6 characters, no simple codes, locks immediately.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.11 (Quad9)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + Extra 1.1 · PIN
profiles.description: Level 1 (Quad9) plus the stronger PIN policy.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.12 (Mullvad)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + Extra 1.2 · Safari
profiles.description: Level 1 (Mullvad) plus a Safari deny list for social and ad sites. Apps are not removed.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.12 (Quad9)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + Extra 1.2 · Safari
profiles.description: Level 1 (Quad9) plus the Safari website deny list.

sections.title: Level 2.2x — two extras
sections.description: Level 1 plus both extras in one file. Later .22 / .23 slots are reserved if more extras ship.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.21 (Mullvad)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + PIN + Safari
profiles.description: Mullvad DNS, Max Privacy, stronger PIN, and Safari website list.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 2.21 (Quad9)
profiles.subtitle: Level 1 + PIN + Safari
profiles.description: Quad9 DNS, Max Privacy, stronger PIN, and Safari website list.

sections.title: OpenHat Extras — add-ons only
sections.description: Install these on top of Level 1 if you did not pick a Level 2 bundle. Extra 1.1 is PIN. Extra 1.2 is Safari.

profiles.title: OpenHat Extras 1.1
profiles.subtitle: Stronger PIN only
profiles.description: Passcode policy only. Use if Level 1 is already installed and you do not want a Level 2.11 bundle.

profiles.title: OpenHat Extras 1.2
profiles.subtitle: Safari block list only
profiles.description: Safari website deny list only. Does not affect Instagram, Snapchat, or other apps.

sections.title: Level 3 — supervised · erases the iPhone
sections.description: Everything: Level 1, Extra 1.1, Extra 1.2, plus Supervised app hides. Requires Apple Configurator Prepare, which wipes the device.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 3 (Mullvad)
profiles.subtitle: After Configurator Prepare only
profiles.description: Full stack with Mullvad DNS. Hides tracking apps and applies Supervised-only locks. Only install after the phone is supervised.

profiles.title: OpenHat Security: Level 3 (Quad9)
profiles.subtitle: After Configurator Prepare only
profiles.description: Full stack with Quad9 DNS. Same Supervised locks as Level 3 (Mullvad).
